```yaml
name: Update uv.lock

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
      - develop
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
      - develop

jobs:
  update-uv-lock:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install uv
      uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        activate-environment: true
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Run uv lock
      run: uv lock

    - name: Check if lockfile has changed
      id: check-changes
      run: |
        git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD
        echo "::set-output name=has_changes::$?"
      shell: bash

    - name: Commit and push changes
      if: github.event_name == 'push' && steps.check-changes.outputs.has_changes == '0'
      uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
      with:
        add: 'uv.lock'
        commit: 'Update uv.lock'
        author_name: 'GitHub Actions'
        author_email: 'github-actions@example.com'
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Fail PR if lockfile is out of sync
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.check-changes.outputs.has_changes == '1'
      run: echo "Lockfile is out of sync. Please manually run 'uv lock' and commit the changes." && exit 1
```
